#+title: Pinned Foundry job mechanism

These six unmodified Source files come from the revision and exact file
hashes in manifest.json. The coordinator packages this mechanism directly.
The language owns the CLI entry adapter in nix/preparation-jobs.bl. Host policy,
preparation operation dispatch and systemd worker containment
live outside this snapshot. Updating it means importing an upstream revision,
recording its hashes and qualifying the packaged coordinator in the main thread.
